Professor Ming Qing Zhu

Professor Ming Qing Zhu is the founder and developer of Zhu’s Scalp Acupuncture (ZSA). This website documents his clinical legacy and the educational transmission represented by Dr. Ru Shan Shy and Dr. Sheng Chun Chang.

Clinical legacy and educational transmission.

This website uses historical records to document the lineage connecting Professor Zhu with Dr. Ru Shan Shy and Dr. Sheng Chun Chang.
